summary: Verification of new Xcel credentials-diagnostic flow. (1) Railway production endpoint verification — all 3 endpoints return HTTP 401 {"detail":"No autorizado"} without admin auth, proving they exist and are protected: GET /api/admin/xcel/application-information ✅, GET /api/admin/xcel/read-service-status ✅, GET /api/admin/xcel/status ✅. (2) Production OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json lists 17 Xcel/GreenButton routes (>=16 target met), including both new diagnostic endpoints. (3) Static analysis of /app/app/admin/energia/page.tsx: runs `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` → ZERO TypeScript errors specific to this file. The two new buttons exist with the exact requested testIDs (data-testid='diag-app-info-btn' at line 254 + data-testid='diag-service-status-btn' at line 263); runDiag() calls the correct paths and includes Authorization: Bearer ${token} header derived from useAdminAuth() (lines 39-43, 58-79). Next.js rewrites in /app/next.config.js correctly proxy /api/* → https://ross-house-backend-production.up.railway.app/api/*. (4) Expo mobile preview regression at http://localhost:3000 — bundles cleanly (Metro), renders welcome screen 'Bienvenido a Ross House Rentals' at 390x844 viewport, no red-screen, no pageerror, only pre-existing deprecation warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents + expo-notifications web compat — unchanged from iteration_8). Per main-agent context, admin Next.js is only deployed via Vercel (not localhost) so a live UI click-through of the new diagnostic buttons is not possible from this sandbox — verified through static analysis + production endpoint behavior. NOTE: existing TS errors in OTHER admin pages (contratos, marketplace, propiedades, propietarios, rendimiento, inversor/layout) are pre-existing and unrelated to this change; next.config.js sets `typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true` so the Vercel build will still succeed.

critical_code_review_comments: runDiag() correctly uses a relative '/api/...' path which the Next.js rewrite in next.config.js proxies to Railway. Good — no CORS exposure, no hardcoded backend URL in the page.

diagResult typing is conservative ({kind, ok, status_code?, body_preview?, detail?}) — matches the backend ReadServiceStatus/ApplicationInformation envelope shape that returns {ok, status_code, body_preview}. Solid.
Both diagnostic buttons share a single disabled-when-busy state (diagBusy !== null) which correctly prevents double-clicking either button while one is in flight.
Pre-existing: /app/app/admin/energia/page.tsx is 512 lines — under the 700-line guideline, no split needed yet.

rca_of_issue: Original report: user got 'No autorizado' when hitting /api/admin/xcel/application-information from a browser without an admin session — that response is CORRECT behavior (401 'No autorizado' is the intended guard via the require_admin_user dependency). The fix added 2 diagnostic buttons to /admin/energia that send the admin Bearer token automatically, so the user can verify Xcel sandbox credentials without manually constructing curl/cookie requests. Verified end-to-end except for the actual UI click (admin frontend is on Vercel, not local) — all components confirmed via static analysis + live Railway endpoint probing.
